prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on your needs (B2B vs B2C), services required (SEO, paid media, branding, creative, PR, digital product), budget, timeline, and company size. That said, Kansas City has several highly regarded agencies (e.g., Barkley and VML have big KC presences) and a healthy mix of full-service and specialist shops.

To help you pick, tell me:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, product launch, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (strategy, SEO, paid ads, social, creative/branding, web/app development, PR)
- Budget range (monthly or project)?
- Timeline and geographic focus (local, regional, national)?
- Any industry specifics (healthcare, finance, manufacturing, tech, retail)?

If you’d like right now, I can:
- Recommend a short, tailored shortlist of 3–5 Kansas City agencies matched to your answers
- Provide a ready-made RFP or list of questions to ask agencies during vetting
- Pull recent case studies and reviews for the finalists

Which would you prefer?
